oil_life_monitor: An oil replacement indicator is displayed when an oil change is due. If the indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km).

maintenance_items.notes: Replace at every 10,000-mile / 12-month interval (20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, etc.). If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km).
Appears at every 5,000-mile / 6-month interval throughout the schedule. When rotating tires, check for damage and uneven wear.
Replace at 15,000; 30,000; 45,000; 60,000; 75,000; 90,000 miles etc. (every 15,000 miles / 18 months). When driving for prolonged periods in dusty conditions, replace more frequently.
Inspected at 15,000 miles. First replacement at 30,000 miles, then every 15,000 miles / 18 months (30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, etc.).
Replace at 30,000; 60,000; 90,000 miles etc. (every 30,000 miles / 36 months). If operating mainly in dusty conditions, more frequent maintenance may be required.

Factory-fill coolant life expectancy is 105,000 miles (168,000 km) or 7 years. Subsequent replacement interval not explicitly stated in provided pages; 30,000 miles / 36 months is inferred. Mixing any other type of coolant or use of non-distilled water will reduce the life expectancy. Use only Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent.
Replace at 20,000; 40,000; 60,000; 80,000; 100,000; 120,000 miles etc. (every 20,000 miles / 24 months) per standard schedule.
Under severe conditions, brake fluid replacement appears at 15k, 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 110k miles (approximately every 10,000 miles / 12 months, first at 15,000 miles / 18 months).
Inspect CVT fluid under standard schedule at 20k, 30k, 40k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k miles (every 10,000 miles / 12 months, first at 20,000 miles / 24 months).
Replace CVT fluid under severe use conditions at 60,000 miles / 72 months (per p517). Use Genuine NISSAN CVT Fluid NS-3 only.
Inspect manual transmission gear oil under standard schedule at 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k miles (every 10,000 miles / 12 months, first at 20,000 miles / 24 months).
Replace manual transmission gear oil under severe conditions at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 120k miles (every 20,000 miles / 24 months). Use Genuine NISSAN Gear Oil NFX 75W.

Inspect starting at 40,000 miles, then at 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k miles (every 10,000 miles / 12 months after first at 40k). Check for wear, fraying or cracking and for proper tension. Replace any damaged drive belt. Recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; not required to maintain emission warranty.

Inspect at every 20,000-mile / 24-month interval (20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k). Visually inspect for proper installation; check for chafing, cracks, deterioration, and signs of leaking.

maintenance_items.item: Brake pads, rotors, drums and linings
maintenance_items.notes: Inspect at every 5,000-mile / 6-month interval under severe use conditions.
Inspect at 20,000; 40,000; 60,000; 80,000; 120,000 miles. Check vapor lines for leaks or looseness. Recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; not required to maintain emission warranty.

Inspect at 20,000; 40,000; 60,000; 80,000; 120,000 miles. Check fuel hoses, piping and connections for leaks, looseness, or deterioration. Recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; not required to maintain emission warranty.
Inspect under standard schedule at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 120k miles (every 20,000 miles / 24 months). Visually inspect exhaust pipes, muffler and hangers for leaks, cracks, deterioration, and damage.
Inspect at every 5,000-mile / 6-month interval under severe use conditions.

maintenance_items.notes: Inspect under standard schedule at 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k(not listed), 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k miles. Check for damage, looseness, and leakage of oil or grease.

maintenance_items.item: Steering gear and linkage, axle and suspension parts
maintenance_items.notes: Inspect at every 5,000-mile / 6-month interval under severe use conditions.

Inspect at every 5,000-mile / 6-month interval under severe use conditions.
Replace at specified intervals per p508. Install new plugs of the type as originally equipped. Specific mileage interval not stated in the provided pages.
Inspect only if valve noise increases. Adjust valve clearance if necessary. Recommended by NISSAN for reliable vehicle operation; not required to maintain emission warranty.

extraction_caveats: 1. The schedule pages extracted cover milestones from 15,000 through 120,000 miles; pages for 100,000 and 105,000-mile milestones were not included — spark plug replacement interval is referenced but not numerically specified in the extracted pages. 2. Engine oil change interval is inferred as every 10,000 miles / 12 months based on the pattern of 'Replace engine oil & filter' appearing at 20k, 30k, 40k, 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k miles. 3. The tire rotation interval of 5,000 miles / 6 months is inferred from the pattern of rotation appearing at every 5,000-mile milestone. 4. The in-cabin microfilter replacement interval of 15,000 miles / 18 months is inferred from the pattern at 15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k miles. 5. Intelligent Key battery is inspected at 15k but first replaced at 30k, then every 15k. 6. CVT fluid, brake fluid, and manual transmission fluid capacities are listed as '—' (not specified) in the fluids table. 7. Engine coolant first-replacement interval of 105,000 miles / 7 years is explicitly stated (pages 464–465); subsequent replacement interval is not explicitly stated in the provided pages. 8. Engine drive belts inspection starts at 40,000 miles, then appears at 50k, 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k. 9. Brake lines and cables inspection appears at 20k, 30k (p514 lists it), 50k (p516 lists it), 60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 120k — approximately every 10k starting at 20k, though the exact pattern varies. 10. Pages 554-557 are index pages and do not contain maintenance schedule data.
